d: The Timberwolves defeated the Thunder, 113-106 tonight in Oklahoma City. Jaden McDaniels contributed a team-high 32 points to go with 10 rebounds 5 assists and 4 three pointers, with LaMelo Ball of the Timberwolves adding an additional 19 points (7-18 FG, 5-9 3P) in the game. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 32 points along with 5 assists for the Thunder in the losing effort. The Timberwolves improve their record to 14-5 with the win, while the Thunder fall to 10-9 for the season.
